text:
Arjun (People Ops): short convo 1st time transfer - Ramesh moving from EU infra to US infra org. Needs comp-band swap L5 -> L6 provisional, benefits start aligned to US payroll and visa processing. Can we route an exception?
Tess (Hiring Manager): +1. Ramesh is already greenlit by tech lead. He requested 2026-05-01 US office start. We need benefits effective on first day or bridging stipend.
Becky (Recruiter): candidate accepted internal transfer verbally. Curious about final base: current base EUR->USD conversion makes comp look lower. Manager proposed $150k -> $170k pro-rated.
Omar (Payroll): note payroll cutoff: hires effective before midnight on the 1st enter benefits for that month, otherwise next cycle. If start 2026-05-01 and paperwork late, benefits might start 06/01. We can do a one-time bridging stipend to cover gap. Need exact amounts and GL.
Arjun (People Ops): provisional numbers: base $170,000 (L6 provisional), bridging stipend $2,500/mo for up to 2 months, one-time relocation processing $4,000. Rationale doc: https://redwood-internal/hr/transfers/ramesh-2026.pdf
Ivy (Comp Chair): uplift is $20k base -> our policy needs comp-committee signoff for >$15k. Please attach comp comp table + peer comps.
Tess (Hiring Manager): uploaded peer comps and manager note in packet. Link: https://redwood-internal/docs/comp-tables/ramesh-peers.xlsx
Legal (Legal): for internals crossing regions we need standard cost-of-living and relocation addendum and visa clause. I'll attach amendment.
hr-bot: policy note: "Internal transfer band adjustments >$15,000 require Comp Committee + VP signoff" (policy id HR-INT-009). Template: /templates/internal-transfer-amendment-v2.docx
Becky (Recruiter): candidate ok with provisional band for 90 days and clawback for sign-on if they leave within 12 months.
Arjun (People Ops): routing plan: comp-committee -> payroll (GL: 6102.2100) -> legal -> VP Eng approval. Target: complete by 2026-04-28 to send final amendment.
Omar (Payroll): GL accepted, need iso code for EU->US payroll transfer and effective payroll date. Also need payroll contact in new location.
Tess (Hiring Manager): assigning payroll contact: julia.payroll@redwood.com. Start date locked 2026-05-01.
Ivy (Comp Chair): scheduling quick review now. If docs are complete we'll approve; otherwise we'll request more comps.
Arjun (People Ops): approved by comp-committee (fast-track) pending legal language.
Legal (Legal): added relocation & COL addendum and visa wording. Signed off.
Omar (Payroll): confirmed bridging stipend setup and benefits to be active 2026-05-01. Payroll will flag pro-rated first paycheck.
Arjun (People Ops): finalizing amendment and sending to Ramesh at 14:00 PT today. Will close thread after signed acceptance and HR upload. Thanks everyone :raised_hands:
